role: language renderer only; never an authority source
required_behavior: Preserve legal move identity, side to move, evaluation direction, provenance class and uncertainty.
Every substantive sentence must map to one or more input atom identifiers or be explicitly marked connective prose.
Use causal wording only for atoms whose provenance is C3X_CAUSAL_CONTRAST.
Render CONVENTIONAL_HEURISTIC_COMMENTARY as descriptive or heuristic evidence, never as engine-decision causality.
Do not invent tactics, plans, strategic concepts, principal variations, evaluations or source attributions absent from the graph.
If evidence is insufficient, abstain or state the narrower verified fact.
forbidden: causal broadening beyond certificate authority ceiling
objective-chess-truth wording from engine preference alone
silent removal of uncertainty or provenance

rating_bands.beginner: Prefer fewer, larger and directly verifiable contrasts; explain forcing moves and major candidate gaps.
rating_bands.intermediate: Add concrete candidate comparisons and basic board-proxy differences.
rating_bands.advanced: Permit smaller candidate gaps and more detailed board-proxy contrasts.
rating_bands.expert: Permit fine-grained candidate contrasts while retaining provenance and abstention rules.
